title: TUI: show a permission call's whole command
lead: *Proposed.* The TUI's run pane and question view show a permission question's `detail` in full, wrapped, under its title.
findings_note: S370 (2026-11-16): the permission question title is now a 120-character preview with the whole input in the question's `detail` field (adj 368); the TUI shows only the title. Owner decision adj 369 (`ui.permission-detail`, later-slice).

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: *Proposed.* An allow decision depends on every token of the command; the owner answers from the TUI as often as from the CLI.

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
- `TestPermissionQuestionShowsDetail`: a pending permission question with a 300-character detail renders the whole detail, wrapped at the pane width, under the title (golden).
- `TestQuestionWithoutDetailUnchanged`: a question with no detail renders as today.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. Red tests, then the view.
2. Docs: `docs/dashboard.md`. CHANGELOG.md: one bullet under `## Unreleased`.
